```{r}
getwd()
setwd("/Users/nagydomonkos/Desktop/neuroscience/4/eeg_project/EEG_data")
d1 <- read.csv("data_psoren.csv")
d2 <- read.csv("data_pwilliam.csv")
m1 <- read.csv("data_psoren_memory.csv")
m2 <- read.csv("data_pwilliam_memory.csv")

# create a new column in m1 and m2 to indicate if word has appeared in d1 and d2 respectively
m1$appeared <- ifelse(m1$Word %in% d1$Word, 1, 0)
m2$appeared <- ifelse(m2$Word %in% d2$Word, 1, 0)

# create a new column in m1 and m2 to indicate if word has appeared in Condition_Prompt 1 or 2 or has not appeared; d1 and d2 respectively
m1$Condition_Prompt <- ifelse(m1$Word %in% d1$Word[d1$Condition_ID == 1], "Superficial", ifelse(m1$Word %in% d1$Word[d1$Condition_ID == 2], "Deep", "Not appeared"))
m2$Condition_Prompt <- ifelse(m2$Word %in% d2$Word[d2$Condition_ID == 1], "Superficial", ifelse(m2$Word %in% d2$Word[d2$Condition_ID == 2], "Deep", "Not appeared"))

#create a column in d1 and d2 to indicate if word was later remembered in m1 and m2 respectively
d1$remembered <- ifelse(d1$Word %in% m1$Word[m1$Response == "y"], 1, 0)
d2$remembered <- ifelse(d2$Word %in% m2$Word[m2$Response == "y"], 1, 0)

# get row number of trials in d1 and d2 that were later remembered
remembered_d1 <- d1$Word[d1$remembered == 1]
remembered_d2 <- d2$Word[d2$remembered == 1]
# get indices of trials in d1 and d2 that were not remembered later
not_remembered_d1 <- d1$Word[d1$remembered == 0]
not_remembered_d2 <- d2$Word[d2$remembered == 0]
```

```{r}
setwd("/Users/nagydomonkos/Desktop/neuroscience/4/eeg_project/EEG_data")
t1 <- read.csv("triggers_psoren.csv")
t2 <- read.csv("triggers_pwilliam.csv")

#create a new column in t1 and t2 to indicate if word was later remembered based on d1 and d2 respectively. only put 1 or 0 if trigger_code is 4 or 5
t1$remembered <- ifelse(t1$trigger_code %in% c(4, 5) & t1$word %in% remembered_d1, 1, ifelse(t1$trigger_code %in% c(4, 5) & t1$word %in% not_remembered_d1, 0, NA))
t2$remembered <- ifelse(t2$trigger_code %in% c(4, 5) & t2$word %in% remembered_d2, 1, ifelse(t2$trigger_code %in% c(4, 5) & t2$word %in% not_remembered_d2, 0, NA))

#get csvs
write.csv(t1, "triggers_psoren_with_remembered.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(t2, "triggers_pwilliam_with_remembered.csv", row.names = FALSE)

#change trigger code from 4 to 40 if remembered is 0 and to 41 if remembered is 1 in t1 and t2; change trigger code from 5 to 50 if remembered is 0 and to 51 if remembered is 1 in t1 and t2
t1$trigger_code <- ifelse(t1$trigger_code == 4 & t1$remembered == 0, 40, ifelse(t1$trigger_code == 4 & t1$remembered == 1, 41, ifelse(t1$trigger_code == 5 & t1$remembered == 0, 50, ifelse(t1$trigger_code == 5 & t1$remembered == 1, 51, t1$trigger_code))))
t2$trigger_code <- ifelse(t2$trigger_code == 4 & t2$remembered == 0, 40, ifelse(t2$trigger_code == 4 & t2$remembered == 1, 41, ifelse(t2$trigger_code == 5 & t2$remembered == 0, 50, ifelse(t2$trigger_code == 5 & t2$remembered == 1, 51, t2$trigger_code))))
write.csv(t1, "triggers_psoren_with_remembered.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(t2, "triggers_pwilliam_with_remembered.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# determine correctness of responses in m1 and m2; if appeared == 1 and Response == "y then correct, if appeared == 0 and Response == "n" then correct, else incorrect
m1$correct <- ifelse((m1$appeared == 1 & m1$Response == "y") | (m1$appeared == 0 & m1$Response == "n"), 1, 0)
m2$correct <- ifelse((m2$appeared == 1 & m2$Response == "y") | (m2$appeared == 0 & m2$Response == "n"), 1, 0)
```


```{r}
library(lme4)
#run logistic regression for accuracy with Condition_Prompt as predictor
logistic_model <- glmer(correct ~ Condition_Prompt + (1|ID), data = data_full, family = binomial)
summary(logistic_model)
```

```{r}
ggplot(accuracy_condition, aes(x = Condition_Prompt, y = accuracy)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = accuracy - 1.96 * se, 
                    ymax = accuracy + 1.96 * se), 
                width = 0.2) +
  ggtitle("Accuracy in different conditions") +
  xlab("Condition Prompt") +
  ylab("Accuracy")


# Get model predictions with confidence intervals
newdata <- data.frame(
  Condition_Prompt = unique(data_full$Condition_Prompt)
)

# Predict on log-odds scale then convert to probability
pred <- predict(logistic_model, newdata = newdata, 
                re.form = NA,        # population-level estimates only (no random effects)
                type = "link", 
                se.fit = TRUE)

newdata$estimate <- plogis(pred$fit)
newdata$lower    <- plogis(pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit)
newdata$upper    <- plogis(pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit)

# Plot
ggplot() +
  # Jittered raw data points at 0 and 1
  geom_jitter(
    data = data_full,
    aes(x = Condition_Prompt, y = correct, colour = Condition_Prompt),
    width = 0.35, height = 0.02,   # small vertical jitter to separate overlapping points
    alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2
  ) +
  # Model estimates with 95% CI errorbars
  geom_point(
    data = newdata,
    aes(x = Condition_Prompt, y = estimate),
    size = 4, colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_line(data = newdata,
            aes(x = Condition_Prompt, y = estimate, group = 1),
            linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = newdata,
    aes(x = Condition_Prompt, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8, colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
    labels = c("0\n(Forgotten)", "0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1\n(Remembered)")
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("steelblue", "tomato", "seagreen")) +
  labs(
    x = "Condition",
    y = "P(Remembered)",
    title = "Recognition accuracy by condition",
    subtitle = "Points = raw trials (jittered) | Dot + errorbar = model estimate ± 95% CI",
    colour = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
data_full_t <- bind_rows(t1, t2)

# change data type of correct column to numeric
data_full_t$rt <- as.numeric(data_full_t$rt)

#create a new column in data_full_t to indicate if resp_y or resp_n was given after cond1_label or cond_label 2. if trigger code is 2 two rows above is cond1_label and if trigger code is 3 two rows above is cond2_label. rename yes and no responses (6 and 5) to 26 and 25 respectively in data_full_t, same for yes and no responses (6 and 5) to 36 and 35 respectively in data_full_t; only change if they are two rows below cond1_label or cond2_label
data_full_t$trigger_code <- ifelse(
  (data_full_t$trigger_code == 6 & lag(data_full_t$trigger_code, n = 2) == 2) | 
    (data_full_t$trigger_code == 6 & lag(data_full_t$trigger_code, n = 2) == 3), 
  ifelse(lag(data_full_t$trigger_code, n = 2) == 2, 26, 36), 
  ifelse(
    (data_full_t$trigger_code == 7 & lag(data_full_t$trigger_code, n = 2) == 2) | 
      (data_full_t$trigger_code == 7 & lag(data_full_t$trigger_code, n = 2) == 3), 
    ifelse(lag(data_full_t$trigger_code, n = 2) == 2, 27, 37), 
    data_full_t$trigger_code
  )
)
data_full_t

# get combined means of rt for trigger codes 26 and 25; 36 and 35 in data_full_t
rt_summary <- data_full_t %>%
  filter(trigger_code %in% c(27, 26, 37, 36)) %>%
  group_by(trigger_code) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rt = mean(rt, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_rt = sd(rt, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )
rt_summary
# combine 26 and 27 into one condition, and 36 and 37 into another condition in rt_summary
rt_summary <- rt_summary %>%
  mutate(
    condition = case_when(
      trigger_code %in% c(26, 27) ~ "Condition 1",
      trigger_code %in% c(36, 37) ~ "Condition 2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rt = mean(mean_rt, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_rt = sqrt(sum(se_rt^2, na.rm = TRUE)) / n()  # Combine SEs
  )
rt_summary

ggplot(rt_summary, aes(x = condition, y = mean_rt)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue", width = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_rt - se_rt, ymax = mean_rt + se_rt), width = 0.2) +
  ggtitle("Mean RT by Condition") +
  xlab("Condition") +
  ylab("Mean RT (ms)")
```

```{r}
#change delimiter to semicolon
library(readr)

words <- read_delim("word_dataset.csv", delim = ";")
#make a new empty column in data_full_t to indicate if response is correct based on words dataset

#if condition is 1 and contains_a is 1 in words and response is 26 in data_full_t, then correct, if condition is 1 and contains_a is 0 in words and response is 27 in data_full_t, then correct, if condition is 2 and living is 1 in words and response is 36 in data_full_t, then correct, if condition is 2 and living is 0 in words and response is 37 in data_full_t, then correct, else incorrect. 
data_full_t$correct <- ifelse(
  (data_full_t$trigger_code == 26 & words$contains_a[match(data_full_t$word, words$word)] == 1) |
    (data_full_t$trigger_code == 27 & words$contains_a[match(data_full_t$word, words$word)] == 0) |
    (data_full_t$trigger_code == 36 & words$living[match(data_full_t$word, words$word)] == 1) |
    (data_full_t$trigger_code == 37 & words$living[match(data_full_t$word, words$word)] == 0),
  1, 0
)

#get accuracy for each condition in data_full_t and combine 26 and 27 into one condition, and 36 and 37 into another condition in accuracy_t
accuracy_t <- data_full_t %>%
  filter(trigger_code %in% c(26, 27, 36, 37)) %>%
  group_by(trigger_code) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sqrt(accuracy * (1 - accuracy) / n())
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = case_when(
      trigger_code %in% c(26, 27) ~ "Condition 1",
      trigger_code %in% c(36, 37) ~ "Condition 2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sqrt(sum(se^2, na.rm = TRUE)) / n()  # Combine SEs
  )
accuracy_t
```
